ruling: You can't concentrate on two spells at once. Casting another concentration spell instantly drops the first.
Effects of the same spell name do NOT stack. If you are under two Bless spells, you only add 1d4 to attack rolls/saving throws, not 2d4.
Multiple sources of the same damage resistance do not stack to create immunity or double resistance. You either have resistance or you don't.
Temporary hit points do NOT stack. If you have 5 temp HP and receive 10, you can choose to keep the 5 or replace them with 10. You do not get 15.
Advantage and Disadvantage do not compound. If you have three sources of advantage and one of disadvantage, they cancel out into a normal straight roll.
If you gain the Extra Attack feature from multiple classes (like Fighter 5 and Paladin 5), they do NOT stack. You still only attack twice when taking the Attack action.
You can cast the Shield spell as a reaction on your turn if you are surprised, but only AFTER your first turn has ended (since surprise prevents reactions until your turn ends).
